name: Sengoku unification victory: one castle missing, save/load, then all castles

steps.code: BuildHeadlessGameSetup(); g_GameParameters:FullRefresh(); local limit=GameConfiguration.GetValue('GAME_TURN_LIMIT'); if limit~=DB.MakeHash('TURNLIMIT_NONE') then error('turn limit not NONE: '..tostring(limit)) end; if PlayerConfigurations[0]:GetLeaderTypeName()~='LEADER_JAC_ODA_NOBUHIDE' or PlayerConfigurations[1]:GetLeaderTypeName()~='LEADER_JAC_DATE_TANEMUNE' then error('setup changed the configured players') end; HideGameSetup(); return 'setup built like Create Game; turn limit NONE'

local marker=GameInfo.Buildings['BUILDING_JAC_REGISTERED_CASTLE']; if not marker then error('castle marker missing') end; if not Game.IsVictoryEnabled('VICTORY_JAC_SENGOKU_UNIFICATION') then error('unification victory disabled') end; if PlayerConfigurations[0]:GetLeaderTypeName()~='LEADER_JAC_ODA_NOBUHIDE' then error('slot 0 is not Oda') end; if Game.GetWinningTeam()~=nil then error('winner at start') end; local human=0; local total=0; JAC_UNIFY_QUEUE={}; JAC_UNIFY_HELDOUT=nil; for _,owner in ipairs(PlayerManager.GetAliveIDs()) do local player=Players[owner]; if player and player:IsMajor() then for _,city in player:GetCities():Members() do if city:GetBuildings():HasBuilding(marker.Index) then total=total+1; if owner~=human then local row={owner=owner,id=city:GetID()}; if PlayerConfigurations[owner]:GetCivilizationTypeName()=='CIVILIZATION_JAC_AINU' and not JAC_UNIFY_HELDOUT then JAC_UNIFY_HELDOUT=row else table.insert(JAC_UNIFY_QUEUE,row) end end end end end end; if total~=56 or not JAC_UNIFY_HELDOUT or #JAC_UNIFY_QUEUE<1 then error('registry/heldout mismatch '..total) end; if not CityManager.TransferCity then error('GameCore TransferCity unavailable') end; return 'registered='..total..' queued='..#JAC_UNIFY_QUEUE..' Ainu held out'

for i=1,5 do if #JAC_UNIFY_QUEUE==0 then break end; local row=table.remove(JAC_UNIFY_QUEUE); local city=CityManager.GetCity(row.owner,row.id); if not city then error('castle missing '..row.owner..':'..row.id) end; CityManager.TransferCity(city,0) end; return #JAC_UNIFY_QUEUE

local marker=GameInfo.Buildings['BUILDING_JAC_REGISTERED_CASTLE'].Index; local human=0; local total=0; local owned=0; for _,owner in ipairs(PlayerManager.GetAliveIDs()) do local player=Players[owner]; if player and player:IsMajor() then for _,city in player:GetCities():Members() do if city:GetBuildings():HasBuilding(marker) then total=total+1; if owner==human then owned=owned+1 end end end end end; if total~=56 or owned~=55 then error('negative count '..owned..'/'..total) end; if Game.GetWinningTeam()~=nil then error('victory with one castle missing') end; return 'negative: one Ainu castle missing; no winner'

local marker=GameInfo.Buildings['BUILDING_JAC_REGISTERED_CASTLE'].Index; local human=Game.GetLocalPlayer(); local ainu=nil; for _,owner in ipairs(PlayerManager.GetAliveIDs()) do if PlayerConfigurations[owner]:GetCivilizationTypeName()=='CIVILIZATION_JAC_AINU' then for _,city in Players[owner]:GetCities():Members() do if city:GetBuildings():HasBuilding(marker) then if ainu then error('multiple held out Ainu castles') end; ainu=city end end end end; if not ainu then error('Ainu held out castle missing') end; CityManager.TransferCity(ainu,human); local owned=0; for _,city in Players[human]:GetCities():Members() do if city:GetBuildings():HasBuilding(marker) then owned=owned+1 end end; if owned~=56 then error('positive count '..owned) end; return 'positive: all registered castles transferred'

condition.code: local winner,v=Game.GetWinningTeam(); if winner==nil and not JAC_UNIFY_END_REQUESTED then JAC_UNIFY_END_REQUESTED=true; UI.RequestAction(ActionTypes.ACTION_ENDTURN) end; return winner==Players[Game.GetLocalPlayer()]:GetTeam() and v~=nil and GameInfo.Victories[v] and GameInfo.Victories[v].VictoryType=='VICTORY_JAC_SENGOKU_UNIFICATION'

steps.code: local winner,v=Game.GetWinningTeam(); if winner~=Players[Game.GetLocalPlayer()]:GetTeam() or not GameInfo.Victories[v] or GameInfo.Victories[v].VictoryType~='VICTORY_JAC_SENGOKU_UNIFICATION' then error('wrong winner '..tostring(winner)..'/'..tostring(v)) end; return '天下統一 fired for human'
